MappingStatus.description:
The epistemic state of one device↔reader mapping (HB §9.7).

Deliberately contains **no** identifiability value (``analysis/E-…`` C1):
identifiability is a separate axis, carried by ``MappingCell.identifiability``
as an :class:`~wattmosaic_engine.contracts.foundation.IdentifiabilityStatus`.
MappingStatus.title: MappingStatus

ObservabilityV3.description:
The seven HB §9.7 observability states.

This is the ``V3``-suffixed public name because the legacy surface owns the
four-state ``MappingObservability`` vocabulary.  K03 publishes the same
seven-state set as ``Observability``; a cell's ``mapping.observability`` is
stored as one of these values.
ObservabilityV3.title: ObservabilityV3
